# Tune schemas, queries, and hypertables

Start with indexes and schema shape, then move to tablespaces, constraints, and external data only when those levers match your bottleneck. **Jobs to be done:** fundamentals first (schema and indexing), then alter schemas and manage tablespaces, then hypertables and queries. Add JSON, triggers, and FDWs when your workload needs them.
